items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: So, Walter Blaufus had the orchestra down there for the skating show and everything.

ctx.x: It was in the basement. In the College Inn.

In the College Inn. And they had an ice skating rink there for the performers. So, Walter Blaufus had the orchestra down there for the skating show and everything. And when he heard that they were going to put in a dance band, he went to the union and kept them from coming in. He kept them from, uh, so that they couldn't join the union. He fixed it up. Oh, yeah, I see. I see. So, uh, the Sherman House said, okay, you can get out and they can, they'll come in anyhow. Well, when Walter was about to lose the job…
